forge.lesson: `python3 -m venv` fails in the create sandbox because there is no ensurepip/pip (Ubuntu 26.04, Python 3.14, root, no sudo). Run `timeout 200 apt-get install -y -q python3.14-venv` first, then `python3 -m venv /opt/calc && /opt/calc/bin/pip install -q --no-cache-dir pyscf numpy matplotlib` (about 35 s).

The sandbox Python (3.14) differs from the target image (Ubuntu 24.04, Python 3.12). Write `pip freeze | grep -v '^setuptools' > requirements.txt`, then confirm that every pin has cp312 wheels with `pip download -d whl312 --only-binary=:all: --python-version 3.12 -r requirements.txt` (about 13 s).

For tests that do not depend on pyscf being trusted, use reference values from Szabo & Ostlund: H2 RHF/STO-3G at R=1.4 bohr gives -1.1167 Eh (delta 1e-4), plus an FCI check. Also check that the pins match the installed versions, and draw a PNG headlessly with MPLBACKEND=Agg and a temporary MPLCONFIGDIR. The whole suite runs in about 3 s.

There is no bare `pip` command in the create sandbox (`pip: command not found`) and system python3 has no numpy. Do not probe with `pip download` or `pip --version`; use `/opt/calc/bin/pip` once the venv exists.

A layout that passed is check_env.py (versions, numpy eigenvalues [[2,1],[1,2]] = 1 and 3, scipy integral of exp(-x^2) = sqrt(pi), pyscf H2/He/H-UHF STO-3G against S&O within 2e-4, Agg PNG) plus test_check_env.py with negative cases (wrong pin detected; Dockerfile.fragment uses only RUN/ENV/WORKDIR/LABEL), with 2 manifest tests. pyscf computed H2 -1.116714, He -2.807784, H(UHF) -0.466582.

The capability needs these files: requirements.txt, Dockerfile.fragment, calc_smoke.py, test_calc_image.py, README.md and manifest.json. The manifest lists 2 tests, and `captest.py` must report 2/2 before you finish. Do not build the Docker image itself, because the independent test step verifies it.
Fastest passing run so far: 9.5 min end to end (create 7.0 min, test 2.4 min; 12 tool calls, $0.36) on the default Modal sandbox. Plan time and budget from it.

Unpinned `pip install pyscf numpy matplotlib scipy` in the venv took 31 s and resolved pyscf==2.14.0, numpy==2.5.3, scipy==1.18.1, matplotlib==3.11.2. Freeze these, then append `setuptools==84.0.0` explicitly to requirements.txt, because the grep step strips it.

Timing for this run: about 2 min waiting for a Claude account, create 7.3 min (agent 5.1 min, 9 tool calls), and the fresh-sandbox test 4.0 min with no agent. Expect about 11 min end to end and about $0.32.

small-calc.lesson: Reuse run_calc.py's structure (reads element, charge, ecc_scaling, water_model_charges from task.json) so the same script works for any ion. Launch it immediately after the install; it finishes in ~27 s, so draft the manuscript afterward and fill numbers from result.json.

For counterpoise in PySCF, label ghost atoms `ghost-Na`/`ghost-O` and pass an explicit basis dict `{label: gto.basis.load('def2-tzvp', sym)}`; this worked first try for the 5-SCF CP calculation (6.9 s).

Don't present the pointwise ratio E_DFT/E_Coulomb(full) as an 'effective scaling factor' supporting 0.75: it varies from 0.07 at 1.7 Å to 1.28 at 3.0 Å. Note in the methods that the task's water geometry (0.9572 Å/104.52°) is the experimental/TIP3P one, not SPC/E (1.0 Å/109.47°), even though SPC/E charges are used.

After copying /app/small-calc/run_calc.py, change `ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc="lower right")` to `loc="upper right"` with sed BEFORE the first launch. The lower-right legend hides the minimum and the star in fig1.png, and fixing it afterwards cost a second ~34 s run.
From the agent's notes-to-self: Machine has 1 CPU core (`nproc` = 1): DFT will be slow-ish, keep the scan to def2-SVP and only one TZVP point.

From the agent's notes-to-self: `python3 -m venv /opt/calc`: FAILED "ensurepip is not available" (Python 3.14, Ubuntu). Fix: `apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq python3-venv`, then re-run venv + `pip install -q pyscf numpy matplotlib` → PySCF 2.14.0, numpy 2.5.3, matplotlib 3.11.2. The whole chain took 28 s in one background nohup.

First check the environment with `/opt/calc/bin/python -c "import pyscf, numpy, matplotlib"`. With the small-calc-env image it is preinstalled (PySCF 2.14.0), so skip the apt/venv/pip steps entirely and go straight to `cp /app/small-calc/run_calc.py . && mkdir -p results && nohup /opt/calc/bin/python run_calc.py > output.log 2>&1 &`.

Check `/opt/calc/bin/python -c "import pyscf, numpy, matplotlib"` first (0.7 s). In this image (small-calc-env v1) PySCF 2.14.0, numpy 2.5.3 and matplotlib 3.11.2 were preinstalled, so skip apt, venv and pip entirely when the import works.

Reference values for Na+ (B3LYP): r_min 2.2 Å on the SVP grid; CP def2-TZVP −25.46 kcal/mol (uncorrected −26.05, BSSE 0.59); def2-SVP overbinds at −32.23; Coulomb at r_min full −30.44 vs ECC(0.75) −22.83 kcal/mol. The DFT/Coulomb(full) ratios were 0.073, 1.059, 1.279 and 0.836, nearly the same as for K+, but recompute them from result.json rather than copying them.

Before finishing, run these checks: `grep -c TBD results/manuscript.md`, then count abstract words with an awk extraction (159 words passed), then confirm that every [n] citation is in the reference list. The check accepted 4 display equations, 1 figure and citations [1,3,5,6].

Don't `cat result.json` while the script is still running: that poll exited non-zero and was reported as a tool failure. Use `sleep 12; tail output.log` and then read result.json once the run is done. The full script takes ~34 s (17-point SVP scan ~25 s plus CP TZVP ~8 s).

run_calc.py finishes in about 21 s (17-point scan ~15 s, 5-SCF CP def2-TZVP 5.7 s), so it is done before the first poll. Launch it, write the manuscript draft with placeholders, then fill in the numbers. Before finishing, verify the quoted ratios and the citation-to-quote mapping with a short python check against result.json.

From the agent's notes-to-self: Reusing /app/small-calc/run_calc.py (passed earlier checks) as the base for calc/run_calc.py: `cp` plus a one-line docstring fix, launched with nohup into output.log. It worked first try, no failed commands this run.

Write the manuscript draft before or while launching, and consider spending spare budget on CP def2-TZVP at every scan point (about 2 min) or a finer grid near 2.6 Å.

In the Discussion, state that comparing SPC/E point charges in vacuum with DFT is not a test of ECC. Agreement at one distance comes from cancelling effects, and the curve shapes differ: DFT is more attractive than full charges beyond 2.6 Å (e.g. at 3.3 Å, SVP −17.98 vs Coulomb full −14.20 kcal/mol).

forge.name: calc_smoke.py
forge.description: CLI smoke check for /opt/calc. It checks that the pinned versions match requirements.txt, runs H2 RHF/STO-3G against -1.1167 Eh, and draws a PNG with Agg. It supports --json and --plot.

forge.name: captest.py
forge.description: Provided harness that runs the manifest tests with the policy environment allowlist and writes test_report.json with file sha256s; it is supplied by the backend, not written by the agent.

forge.name: check_env.py
forge.description: Checks the /opt/calc environment: pinned versions, numpy/scipy analytic checks, pyscf STO-3G energies against Szabo & Ostlund, Agg PNG; supports --quick and --json.

forge.name: test_calc_image.py
forge.description: Unittest suite (11 tests, about 3 s) covering pins, mismatch detection, H2 RHF and FCI against Szabo & Ostlund, and headless plotting. Run it with /opt/calc/bin/python.

forge.name: test_check_env.py
forge.description: unittest suite for check_env and the capability files (pin format, allowed Dockerfile.fragment directives, negative pin-mismatch case).

small-calc.name: run_calc.py
small-calc.description: Ion–water B3LYP/def2-SVP distance scan (1.7–3.3 Å, 17 pts), CP-corrected B3LYP/def2-TZVP at the minimum, point-charge Coulomb full vs ECC-scaled energies; writes results/fig1.png and result.json, parameters read from task.json.
